data.title: Global economy to slow less than expected in 2026 as AI boom offsets war hit: IMF
data.summary_raw: The IMF raised its 2026 global growth forecast to 3.1%, as AI investment helped offset the war’s energy shock.

data.title: How Red Bull's F1 team is using AI to make split-second decisions for Max Verstappen
